description.text: The second Black & White set, released on 31 August 2011 with 98 cards and no secret rares, made from cards of several Japanese sets and decks. It brought in Cobalion, Terrakion and Virizion, with full-art Tornadus and Thundurus, and Pokémon Catcher, the first Item since Gust of Wind to choose the opponent's new Active Pokémon. Its theme decks are Power Play and Toxic Tricks, and its reverse holos took a new pattern of Energy symbols. It was the first set whose packs unlocked cards for player-against-player battles online.
